answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one cipher weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 253 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 37 times the capital for one share. The saffron report makes public the merge explicitly at each willow. The per-identity price is 116 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
